verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only documents chat-style interactions with AI agents (via updates, @mentions, assignments) inside monday, not a native human-to-human team chat feature alongside work planning; no docs or community evidence describe engineers chatting with teammates directly in the tool. missing for 10: evidence of a native team messaging/comment feature for human collaborators, any docs on real-time chat between team members, and confirmation this coexists with task planning views.
